title: Southern Arizona: Near-Record Heat Expected Thursday and Friday - Big Warm-Up Ahead - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago According to the Arizona Weatherman, expect the heat to turn up for Southern Arizona on Thursday and Friday, 11-12 Dec 2025, to near-record-breaking levels. A longwave ridge moving over the state will bring this heat streak.
Model Temperature data for Friday, 12 Dec 2025. Photo by Windy.com For Phoenix, expect high temperatures around 80°F and 81°F on Thursday and Friday; for Tucson, expect 81°F and 80°F; and for Yuma, expect 83°F and 84°F. The best chances to beat the record, especially for Phoenix and Tucson, will be on Friday, 12 Dec 2025.
The lovely hot weather in the desert returns after a cool snap. For the snowbirds who love the warmth, they are loving it, and for those who long for the colder, stormier conditions, they will have a bit of a wait.
Source: The Arizona Weatherman, a seasoned meteorologist with over 25 years of experience in aviation meteorology, including service with the United States Air Force, government contracting, and private practice, provides this forecast. His experience training Special Operations Weather Technicians (SOWT) in weather techniques, combined with his state certification as a STEM teacher, further underscores his expertise. His weather predictions are trustworthy.
